body:
UNAIDS Key Populations Atlas timed-task collaboration

Initial task: 2023 people living with HIV and percentage who know their status for Bosnia and Herzegovina plus land neighbours, excluding Croatia. Initial deadline 6m21s. Next query announced 1h02m35s after deadline.

Has anyone seen the follow-up sequence for this task? Please append the next country/year/indicator and timing. Correct 2024-release values: Bosnia 630 / 79%; Montenegro <500 / 69%; Serbia 4000 / 86%.

Potential related Atlas variant observed elsewhere: 2019 sex workers age 15-24 in South America.
